name: Detecting deepfakes, forgeries, and anomalies
gist: Spotting manipulated or fake images and videos, plus detecting unusual or out-of-place content that doesn't fit expectations.
explain: Modern generative models can create synthetic images that look real to the human eye, making it harder to distinguish fakes by inspection. A deepfake is a video of a person saying or doing something they never did, synthesized so convincingly that it fools most viewers. A forged image might have objects added or removed, or stitched together from multiple sources. The ability to create fake media threatens trust in images and video evidence — if you cannot tell real from fake, you cannot trust what you see. But there is a counterforce: research into detecting fakes. When a generative model creates an image, it leaves subtle fingerprints — patterns that do not match how real cameras capture light. The challenge is to find and exploit those patterns before fakes become indistinguishable from reality.

Modern generative models produce images with fewer obvious flaws, which makes detection harder. When deepfakes first appeared, they had obvious artifacts — discontinuities (sharp changes in appearance), blinking at wrong moments, slight spatial distortions. But today's models learn to avoid these tells, producing images that pass casual inspection. This drives an arms race: forensics researchers find new fingerprints, generative models learn to avoid them, researchers find other clues. Detection also requires finding global patterns, not just local artifacts. A single forged face in a video of a thousand frames must be caught — missing one fake ruins the whole purpose. A manipulated object in a complex image must stand out even though the rest looks normal. And the methods must generalize: detect deepfakes made with models the detector has never seen before, which means learning deep principles, not memorizing specific tells.

Approaches to this problem split into several categories. Some are forensic: look for traces left by the generation process, like compression artifacts or frequency patterns that reveal where an image was synthesized. Others are behavioral: face deepfakes often have biological inconsistencies — unusual eye movement, asymmetrical expressions, or lighting inconsistencies. Some use neural detectors trained on real and fake images, learning to spot the difference. Others use frequency-domain analysis: examine the image's Fourier transform for unnatural patterns. A few combine multiple signals: if many weak clues point to fakeness, conclude it is fake even if none alone is conclusive. The underlying principle is that perfect forgery is hard — there is always a trail if you know where to look.

papers.title: All Patches Matter, More Patches Better: Enhance AI-Generated Image Detection via Panoptic Patch Learning
papers.contribution: PPL enhances generalization and robustness of AIGI detection across datasets by ensuring uniform patch utilization.

papers.title: Foundation Visual Encoders Are Secretly Few-Shot Anomaly Detectors
papers.contribution: Supports multi-class detection with competitive performance while surpassing other approaches in model size and inference efficiency.

papers.title: MRAD: Zero-Shot Anomaly Detection with Memory-Driven Retrieval
papers.contribution: Consistently demonstrates superior performance across 16 industrial and medical datasets for both classification and segmentation under train-free and training-based settings.

papers.title: No Pixel Left Behind: A Detail-Preserving Architecture for Robust High-Resolution AI-Generated Image Detection
papers.contribution: HiDA-Net ensures full-pixel coverage for high-resolution detection with superior robustness, introducing HiRes-50K benchmark with 50,568 images up to 64 megapixels.

papers.title: PGC: Peak-Guided Calibration for Generalizable AI-Generated Image Detection
papers.contribution: Achieves state-of-the-art with +12.3% improvement on CommGen15, +2.1% on GenImage, +3.5% on AIGI, and +1.7% on UniversalFakeDetect.

papers.title: Preserving Forgery Artifacts: AI-Generated Video Detection at Native Scale
papers.contribution: Achieves state-of-the-art performance across benchmarks by preserving high-frequency details and spatiotemporal inconsistencies through native-scale processing.

papers.title: CoGeoAD: Hierarchical Color-Geometric Fusion with Multi-View Attention for Zero-Shot 3D Anomaly Detection
papers.contribution: Achieves state-of-the-art performance on MVTec3D-AD and Eyecandies benchmarks, effectively capturing both structural and textural anomalies.

papers.title: Counterfactual Occlusion-Aware Learning via Visibility Intervention for LiDAR Anomaly Detection
papers.contribution: COVAL achieves state-of-the-art performance on standard LiDAR anomaly segmentation benchmarks through counterfactual occlusion-visibility learning.

papers.title: Dissect and Prune: Enhancing Robustness in AI-Generated Image Detection
papers.contribution: Significantly enhances robustness against unseen generators and post-processing operations, mitigating prediction asymmetry.

papers.title: Dual Distillation for Few-Shot Anomaly Detection
papers.contribution: D2-4FAD significantly outperforms existing approaches on curated benchmark of 13,084 medical images across four organs and establishes state-of-the-art few-shot medical anomaly detection.

papers.title: Fleet: Few Shots Lead Effective AI-generated Image Detection
papers.contribution: Restores performance from 20.4% to 73.1% with only 10-shot adaptation on Doubao Seedream 4.0.

papers.title: GenShield: Unified Detection and Artifact Correction for AI-Generated Images
papers.contribution: Achieves state-of-the-art on AIGI detection benchmarks while enabling high-quality artifact correction with explicit stopping criteria.

papers.title: Learning to Watch: Active Video Anomaly Understanding via Interleaved Policy Optimization
papers.contribution: With only 2B parameters, significantly outperforms state-of-the-art large-scale VAU models in complex scenarios.

papers.title: Linguistic Relative Policy Optimization for Video Anomaly Reasoning
papers.contribution: Significantly outperforms state-of-the-art methods on XD-Violence, UCF-Crime, and UBNormal under tuning-free settings via contextual experience injection without parameter updates.

papers.title: Mixture Prototype Flow Matching for Open-Set Supervised Anomaly Detection
papers.contribution: MPFM achieves state-of-the-art performance across diverse benchmarks under both single- and multi-anomaly settings via mode-aware and semantically coherent distribution transport.

papers.title: OmniAID: Decoupling Semantic and Artifacts for Universal AI-Generated Image Detection in the Wild
papers.contribution: Surpasses existing detectors with robust generalization across diverse generative models; introduces Mirage dataset with modern training and challenging test sets.

papers.title: Order within Chaos: Capturing Intrinsic Energy Anomalies for AI-Manipulated Image Forgery Localization
papers.contribution: Establishes state-of-the-art results on AI-generated forgery datasets while generalizing to unseen generative architectures.

papers.title: PRISM: Training-Free Video Anomaly Detection via Intrinsic Statistical Modeling
papers.contribution: Achieves state-of-the-art performance among training-free methods with real-time inference capability.

papers.title: Remove the Ambiguity: Few-shot Multimodal Anomaly Detection Using Crossmodal Feature Replacers
papers.contribution: In 1-shot setting achieves 92.3 and 82.7 AUPRO at 30% FPR on MVTec 3D-AD and Eyecandies with 74.0 and 75.9 image-level AUROC scores.

papers.title: Steering and Rectifying Latent representation manifolds in Frozen Multi-modal LLMs for Video Anomaly Detection
papers.contribution: Achieves state-of-the-art performance among tuning-free approaches while requiring only 1% of training data, establishing active representation steering as a new direction for VAD.

papers.title: TD-VAD: Breaking Visual Dependence in Video Anomaly Detection with Text-Driven Learning
papers.contribution: Breaks visual dependence for VAD training and outperforms one-class and unsupervised methods on XD-Violence and UCF-Crime datasets.

papers.title: Towards Trustworthy Video Anomaly Understanding: A Class-Guided Chain-of-Evaluation Metric and An Anomaly-focused Meta-Benchmark
papers.contribution: CG-CoE achieves state-of-the-art validity and robustness in evaluating video anomaly understanding models.

papers.title: TranX-Adapter: Bridging Artifacts and Semantics within MLLMs for Robust AI-generated Image Detection
papers.contribution: TranX-Adapter brings consistent improvements up to +6% accuracy across AIGI detection benchmarks on multiple advanced MLLMs.

papers.title: Where Detectors Fail: Probing Generative Space for Generalizable AI-Generated Image Detection
papers.contribution: Enhances detector generalization to unseen generators by actively exploring challenging regions of the generative process.
